blocks.h2: When Gas Piping Needs a Plumber

bodies: We find gas leaks with electronic detectors and fitting-by-fitting tests, then pressure-test the system to confirm it's tight.

In older Ravenswood homes, leaks often show up at old unions and valves, on branches left from removed appliances and at original meter connections in the basement. After the repair, Peoples Gas can restore service.

blocks.intro: Gas piping in older homes has been added to many times.

items.body: Many joints, many chances for leaks.

blocks.h2: Gas Repairs in a Building With Two Meters
blocks.body: Most Ravenswood two-flats have a separate gas meter for each unit, and piping that branches out to each unit's stove, water heater and furnace. When Peoples Gas shuts off service, it may be one meter or both. We trace which piping belongs to which meter, find the leak and pressure-test that system, so the right service can be restored and the other unit isn't affected longer than needed.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: What should I do if I smell gas?
items.preview: Leave and call Peoples Gas or 911.
items.answer: Leave without touching switches. Call Peoples Gas or 911 from outside, then call us.

items.q: Who owns the gas piping in a two-flat?
items.answer: Peoples Gas handles everything up to and including the meters. Piping after the meters belongs to the owner.

items.q: Can you cap old gas lines?
items.answer: Yes, and we pressure-test the system after.

items.q: How long until service is restored?
items.answer: Once we repair and test the line, Peoples Gas can restore service.

items.q: Will the other unit lose gas during the repair?
items.answer: Not usually, if the leak is only on one unit's piping.

items.q: How much does gas line repair cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the leak. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on where the leak is and how much pipe needs work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
